extracted.intended_audience: companies, investors, regulators, and environmental NGOs
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the collaborative system (CDP + CDSB) for corporate climate and environmental disclosure: a data-collection platform plus a reporting framework to communicate that data in mainstream reports for investors, stakeholders and regulators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete, reliable and verified system for climate disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: CDP and CDSB work together to provide a complete, reliable and verified system for climate disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The partnership aims to deliver an end-to-end system combining platform and framework so disclosures are comprehensive, trustworthy and subject to verification. (Page frames this as the overall objective of the collaboration.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Structure for data collection
rubrics_metrics.description: CDP's platform provides the structure for data collection and the content for reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Companies should use the CDP platform's defined structure and content templates to collect consistent disclosure data suitable for reporting and comparison.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting content for corporate disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: CDP provides the content for reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclosure content (what to report) is supplied via CDP—organizations should follow that content guidance so reports address the expected metrics and narrative elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting framework to communicate content in mainstream reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Through its reporting framework, CDSB provides the guidance to communicate that content in mainstream reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CDSB's framework guides how to present CDP-collected data within mainstream corporate reports (e.g., annual reports), focusing on clarity, materiality and alignment with investor/stakeholder needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Informing investors and stakeholders
rubrics_metrics.description: The reporting approach 'helps companies inform their investors and stakeholders'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclosures should be prepared and presented to meet investor and stakeholder decision-making needs—i.e., be relevant, material, and accessible to those audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Providing regulators with a comprehensive set of information
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting should provide regulators with a comprehensive set of information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports should contain sufficiently complete and structured information to satisfy regulatory requirements and oversight, enabling regulators to assess corporate climate-related impacts and risks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include elements of environmental and natural capital disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: The system covers climate disclosure and elements of environmental and natural capital disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclosure practices encouraged by the collaboration extend beyond greenhouse gas metrics to include other environmental and natural-capital information where relevant.
